name: Ferry
description: Move a conversation to another provider and back. Providers that share a session store continue the same session; others get a budgeted handoff, and switching back sends only what was missed.

zh-CN.name: 摆渡
zh-CN.description: 把对话交给另一个 Provider 接着做，也能再切回来。共用会话存储的 Provider 直接续同一个会话；其他的按预算交接历史，切回时只补对方错过的部分。
